Module preservation permutation engine (dense)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
module_preservation_dense_cpp.Rd

Module preservation permutation engine (dense)

Usage

module_preservation_dense_cpp(
  net,
  thr,
  keep,
  module_members,
  ref_kIM,
  ref_CC,
  ref_MAR,
  n_perm,
  n_cores,
  binary,
  store_perm
)

Arguments

net

Dense network matrix.

thr

Analysis threshold.

keep

Ascending 0-based indices of the ortholog-mappable genes.

module_members

List of integer vectors: local gene indices per module, ordered to match the reference vectors.

ref_kIM, ref_CC, ref_MAR

Lists of numeric vectors: the reference network's per-gene statistics, one vector per module.

n_perm

Number of permutations.

n_cores

Number of OpenMP threads.

binary

Treat every surviving edge as weight 1.

store_perm

Return the raw per-permutation statistic pairs.

Value

List with observed, perm_mean, perm_sd, n_perm_used, n_exceed, p_value, p_npc, p_joint, n_joint, scale.
